hero.title: FormEmbedModal pattern
hero.description: Primary form CTAs should use the shared modal pattern instead of navigating directly to the provider form.

example.title: Example
example.description: The trigger is an anchor so no-JS fallback navigation still opens in a new tab. This component is provider-agnostic — swap in a JotForm, Google Forms, or any other iframe-embeddable form URL; the example below happens to use a Google Forms URL only because it's an easy one to demo live.
example.helperLink: Having trouble? Open the application in a new tab

controlled.title: Controlled mode
controlled.description: Use controlled mode when page logic needs to open/close the form modal from non-anchor UI controls.

standard.title: Standard
items: In-modal direct link ("Open in new tab") is required.
On-page helper link is required and must use `js-only`.
Modal trigger anchors must use `target="_blank"` + `rel="noopener noreferrer"`.
Modifier-key trigger clicks (Cmd/Ctrl/Shift/Alt) must preserve direct new-tab navigation.
Controlled mode (`open` + `onOpenChange`) is required for external trigger use cases.
No duplicate fallback links in no-JS mode.
`asButton` (default `true`) renders the trigger as a styled button; pass `false` with custom `children` to use your own trigger element.
`triggerVariant`/`triggerSize` (both default `"default"`) control button styling when `asButton` is used.
Standard helper text: `Having trouble? Open the application in a new tab`
